Callout.Name: Protected Escort - Route Threat
Callout.Message: Escort required for a protected transfer.
Callout.Advisory: Route is short, threat is general.

Script.Line: We run four minutes behind. If we lose sight of them we stop.
The route does not change. That is the whole point of it.
If it goes loud it goes loud quickly, and then we leave.

Lines.Approach: Two vehicles, four minutes apart, and the route does not change once it starts.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
